308	    # -- resumable upload sessions -------------------------------------
309	    def _read_length_body(self):
310	        """Read a body framed strictly by Content-Length.
311	
312	        Transfer-Encoding wins over every other problem (400); a missing,
313	        non-integer or negative Content-Length is 411; a body that ends
314	        before the declared length is 400. Returns ``(body, (status,
315	        message))`` with the error element ``None`` on success.
316	        """
317	        if self.headers.get("Transfer-Encoding") is not None:
318	            self.close_connection = True
319	            return None, (400, "transfer encoding not supported")
320	        raw = self.headers.get("Content-Length")
321	        if raw is None or _DECIMAL_RE.match(raw) is None:
322	            self.close_connection = True
323	            return None, (411, "length required")
324	        length = int(raw)
325	        body = self.rfile.read(length) if length else b""
326	        if len(body) != length:
327	            self.close_connection = True
328	            return None, (400, "truncated request body")
329	        return body, None
330	
331	    @staticmethod
332	    def _json_object(body):
333	        """Decode *body* as a UTF-8 JSON object or raise a 400-class error."""
334	        try:
335	            text = body.decode("utf-8")
336	        except UnicodeDecodeError:
337	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid json: body is not utf-8")
338	        try:
339	            document = json.loads(text)
340	        except ValueError:
341	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid json: body is not a json document")
342	        if not isinstance(document, dict):
343	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid json: body must be a json object")
344	        return document
345	
346	    @staticmethod
347	    def _offset_param(query):
348	        """Return the unique non-negative decimal ``offset`` query value."""
349	        params = parse_qs(query, keep_blank_values=True)
350	        values = params.get("offset")
351	        if values is None or len(values) != 1 or _DECIMAL_RE.match(values[0]) is None:
352	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid offset")
353	        return int(values[0])
354	
355	    def _create_upload(self, tenant):
356	        body, error = self._read_length_body()
357	        if error is not None:
358	            return self._error(*error)
359	        document = self._json_object(body)
360	        allowed = {"key", "size", "sha256", "content_type"}
361	        unknown = set(document) - allowed
362	        if unknown:
363	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid json: unknown field %r" % (sorted(unknown)[0],))
364	        missing = [name for name in ("key", "size", "sha256") if name not in document]
365	        if missing:
366	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid json: missing field %r" % (missing[0],))
367	        content_type = document.get("content_type")
368	        # Validate every body value before touching the conditional headers:
369	        # request/body errors keep precedence over precondition errors.
370	        key, size, digest = document["key"], document["size"], document["sha256"]
371	        ContentAddressedStore._check_key(key)
372	        if isinstance(size, bool) or not isinstance(size, int) or size < 0:
373	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid size: %r" % (size,))
374	        ContentAddressedStore._require_sha(digest)
375	        if content_type is not None and not isinstance(content_type, str):
376	            raise ObjectStoreError("content_type must be a string or None")
377	        expected = self._precondition_headers()
378	        session_id = self.server.store.begin_upload(
379	            key, size, digest, content_type=content_type,
380	            expected_sha256=expected, tenant=tenant)
381	        return self._send(201, _json_bytes({"session": session_id}))
382	
383	    def _upload_session(self, method, tail, query, tenant):
384	        # Transfer-Encoding is rejected before method/session validation.
385	        if self.headers.get("Transfer-Encoding") is not None:
386	            self.close_connection = True
387	            return self._error(400, "transfer encoding not supported")
388	        session_id, sep, sub = tail.partition("/")
389	        if not session_id:
390	            return self._error(404, "not found")
391	        if not sep:
392	            return self._upload_session_item(method, session_id, query, tenant)
393	        if sub == "complete":
394	            if method != "POST":
395	                return self._error(405, "method not allowed")
396	            return self._complete_upload(session_id, tenant)
397	        return self._error(404, "not found")
398	
399	    def _upload_session_item(self, method, session_id, query, tenant):
400	        store = self.server.store
401	        if method == "GET":
402	            return self._send(200, _json_bytes(
403	                store.upload_status(session_id, tenant=tenant)))
404	        if method == "DELETE":
405	            store.abort_upload(session_id, tenant=tenant)
406	            return self._send(204, b"")
407	        if method != "PUT":
408	            return self._error(405, "method not allowed")
409	        body, error = self._read_length_body()
410	        if error is not None:
411	            return self._error(*error)
412	        offset = self._offset_param(query)
413	        confirmed = store.append_upload(session_id, offset, body, tenant=tenant)
414	        return self._send(200, _json_bytes({"offset": confirmed}))
415	
416	    def _complete_upload(self, session_id, tenant):
417	        # No body is required, but framing headers still have to be sane and
418	        # any declared bytes are drained so the connection can be reused.
419	        if self.headers.get("Transfer-Encoding") is not None:
420	            self.close_connection = True
421	            return self._error(400, "transfer encoding not supported")
422	        raw = self.headers.get("Content-Length")
423	        if raw is not None:
424	            if _DECIMAL_RE.match(raw) is None:
425	                self.close_connection = True
426	                return self._error(400, "invalid content length")
427	            length = int(raw)
428	            if length:
429	                drained = self.rfile.read(length)
430	                if len(drained) != length:
431	                    self.close_connection = True
432	                    return self._error(400, "truncated request body")
433	        entry = self.server.store.complete_upload(session_id, tenant=tenant)
434	        return self._send(200, _json_bytes(entry))
435	
436	    def _list(self, query, tenant):
437	        params = parse_qs(query, keep_blank_values=True)
438	        raw_limit = params.get("limit", [str(DEFAULT_LIMIT)])[0]
439	        try:
440	            limit = int(raw_limit)
441	        except (TypeError, ValueError):
442	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid limit: %r" % (raw_limit,))
443	        result = self.server.store.list_objects(
444	            prefix=params.get("prefix", [""])[0],
445	            after=params.get("after", [None])[0] or None,
446	            limit=limit,
447	            tenant=tenant,
448	        )
449	        return self._send(200, _json_bytes(result))

451	    # -- versioning and retention ---------------------------------------

536	    def _quota(self, method, tenant):
537	        store = self.server.store

539	            policy = store.get_quota(tenant=tenant) or {}
540	            return self._send(200, _json_bytes({

546	            if error is not None:

564	    def _lifecycle(self, method, tenant):

571	        if method != "PUT":
572	            return self._error(405, "method not allowed")
573	        body, error = self._read_length_body()
574	        if error is not None:
575	            return self._error(*error)
576	        document = self._json_object(body)
577	        unknown = set(document) - {"prefix", "max_age_seconds"}
578	        if unknown:
579	            raise ObjectStoreError(
580	                "invalid json: unknown field %r" % (sorted(unknown)[0],))

585	            "prefix": document.get("prefix", ""),

589	    def _run_lifecycle(self, tenant):
590	        # Framing follows the retention purge endpoint: no body is required,
591	        # but any declared body must be a length-framed JSON object holding at
592	        # most a boolean dry_run field.
593	        if self.headers.get("Transfer-Encoding") is not None:
594	            self.close_connection = True
595	            return self._error(400, "transfer encoding not supported")
596	        dry_run = True
597	        if self.headers.get("Content-Length") is not None:
598	            body, error = self._read_length_body()
599	            if error is not None:
600	                return self._error(*error)
601	            if body:
602	                document = self._json_object(body)
603	                unknown = set(document) - {"dry_run"}
604	                if unknown:
605	                    raise ObjectStoreError(
606	                        "invalid json: unknown field %r" % (sorted(unknown)[0],))
607	                dry_run = document.get("dry_run", True)
608	        result = self.server.store.run_lifecycle(dry_run=dry_run, tenant=tenant)
609	        return self._send(200, _json_bytes(result))

613	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid sha256: %r" % (sha256,))
614	        return self._send(200, self.server.store.blob(sha256), _DEFAULT_CONTENT_TYPE,

1	"""Content-addressed object store (standard library only).
2	
3	Blob bytes are stored once as ``<root>/blobs/<sha256>``; object metadata
4	(``key -> {sha256, size, content_type}``) lives in ``<root>/index.json`` and is
5	always rewritten through a temporary file plus ``os.replace``. Every mutation
6	and every consistent read runs under a single re-entrant lock.
7	
8	Objects are namespaced per tenant: every object and upload operation takes an
9	optional ``tenant`` keyword defaulting to ``"default"``, and the same key in
10	different tenants refers to independent objects. In the index the default
11	tenant keeps the historical flat ``objects`` map while other tenants are
12	stored under a ``tenants`` map, so directories written by older versions
13	silently belong to the default tenant. Blobs stay global: identical content
14	is stored once no matter which tenants reference it, and garbage collection
15	considers the references of every tenant.
16	
17	Object versioning is opt-in per tenant and defaults to off, which keeps the
18	historical behaviour exactly. While a tenant has versioning enabled, every
19	``put`` and every completed resumable upload appends an immutable version
20	(``version_id`` plus content metadata and a UTC ``created_at``) to the key's
21	version list and makes it the current version; reads keep returning only the
22	current version and ``delete`` removes only the current version, promoting
23	the newest remaining one. Versions live in the index's ``versions`` map, the
24	per-tenant enable flags in ``versioning`` and the retention policies in
25	``retention``; indexes written by older versions have none of these maps and
26	therefore no versions. Garbage collection treats blobs referenced by any
27	version, any current object and any incomplete upload session as live.
28	
29	Resumable uploads live under ``<root>/uploads/`` (created lazily): each
30	session is a ``<session>.json`` declaration plus confirmed offset and a
31	``<session>.part`` file holding the received bytes. A session belongs to the
32	tenant fixed at creation; operations naming another tenant behave exactly as
33	if the session did not exist. Completing a session publishes the object in
34	the session's tenant and records the result in the index's ``uploads`` map in
35	one atomic index rewrite, so the completion flag can never disagree with the
36	published object.
37	
38	Each tenant may carry a quota policy (``quota`` map in the index) limiting
39	the logical bytes and objects it may hold. Usage is counted by logical
40	reference, not physical dedup: every current object and every retained
41	version counts once (a current pointer duplicating its newest version is not
42	counted twice), keys sharing a digest count separately, and active upload
43	sessions reserve their declared size until they complete or abort. Writes
44	that would exceed a limit fail with ``ObjectStoreError("quota exceeded")``
45	before any data lands; tenants without a saved policy are unlimited and see
46	no behaviour change.
47	
48	Each current object written by a new version of the store (a ``put`` or a
49	completed resumable upload) carries a comparable UTC ``last_modified``
50	timestamp in the index. Objects in indexes written by older versions have no
51	such field and are treated as timeless: they load without error and
52	lifecycle expiration always skips them. A tenant may also carry a lifecycle
53	policy (``lifecycle`` map in the index) with an optional ``prefix`` (a
54	string, empty when omitted) and a required non-negative integer
55	``max_age_seconds`` (booleans excluded). Running the policy previews or
56	deletes the current objects of that tenant whose keys start with the prefix
57	and whose last-modified time is older than the age, using the same current
58	version removal and promotion rules as ``delete``; lifecycle only drops
59	metadata references, leaving the blob bytes for ``collect_garbage``.
60	"""

107	def _atomic_write(path, data):
108	    """Write *data* to *path* via a unique temp file plus os.replace."""
109	    tmp = "%s.tmp.%d.%d" % (path, os.getpid(), threading.get_ident())
110	    try:
111	        with open(tmp, "wb") as handle:
112	            handle.write(data)
113	            handle.flush()
114	            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
115	        os.replace(tmp, path)
116	    finally:
117	        if os.path.exists(tmp):
118	            try:
119	                os.remove(tmp)
120	            except OSError:
121	                pass

124	class ContentAddressedStore:
125	    """Multi-tenant key -> content-addressed blob mapping persisted on disk."""
126	
127	    def __init__(self, root):
128	        if not isinstance(root, (str, bytes, os.PathLike)):
129	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid root: %r" % (root,))
130	        self.root = os.path.abspath(os.fspath(root))
131	        self.blobs_dir = os.path.join(self.root, BLOBS_DIRNAME)
132	        self.uploads_dir = os.path.join(self.root, UPLOADS_DIRNAME)
133	        self.index_path = os.path.join(self.root, INDEX_NAME)
134	        self._lock = threading.RLock()
135	        os.makedirs(self.blobs_dir, exist_ok=True)
136	        (self._objects, self._timestamps, self._upload_records,
137	         self._versioning, self._versions, self._retention, self._quota,
138	         self._lifecycle) = self._load_index()
139	        self._uploads = self._load_uploads()
140	
141	    # -- index ---------------------------------------------------------
142	    def _load_index(self):
143	        if not os.path.exists(self.index_path):
144	            return {DEFAULT_TENANT: {}}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
145	        try:
146	            with open(self.index_path, "rb") as handle:
147	                document = json.loads(handle.read().decode("utf-8"))
148	        except (OSError, ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:
149	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: %s" % (exc,))
150	        if not isinstance(document, dict) or not isinstance(document.get("objects"), dict):
151	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: missing objects map")
152	        objects, timestamps = {DEFAULT_TENANT: {}}, {}
153	        default_objects, default_times = self._load_object_map(
154	            document["objects"])
155	        objects[DEFAULT_TENANT] = default_objects
156	        if default_times:
157	            timestamps[DEFAULT_TENANT] = default_times
158	        raw_tenants = document.get("tenants", {})
159	        if not isinstance(raw_tenants, dict):
160	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: tenants is not a map")
161	        for tenant, mapping in raw_tenants.items():
162	            if not isinstance(tenant, str) or tenant == DEFAULT_TENANT \
163	                    or _TENANT_RE.match(tenant) is None:
164	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad tenant")
165	            if not isinstance(mapping, dict):
166	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad tenant objects")
167	            tenant_objects, tenant_times = self._load_object_map(mapping)
168	            objects[tenant] = tenant_objects
169	            if tenant_times:
170	                timestamps[tenant] = tenant_times
171	        records = {}
172	        raw_records = document.get("uploads", {})
173	        if not isinstance(raw_records, dict):
174	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: uploads is not a map")
175	        for session_id, record in raw_records.items():
176	            if not isinstance(session_id, str) or not isinstance(record, dict):
177	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad upload record")
178	            key = record.get("key")
179	            if not isinstance(key, str):
180	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad upload record")
181	            tenant = record.get("tenant", DEFAULT_TENANT)
182	            if not isinstance(tenant, str) or _TENANT_RE.match(tenant) is None:
183	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad upload record")
184	            records[session_id] = {
185	                "key": key,
186	                "entry": self._validate_entry(key, record.get("entry"))[0],
187	                "tenant": tenant,
188	            }
189	            version_id = record.get("version_id")
190	            if version_id is not None:
191	                if not isinstance(version_id, str) \
192	                        or _VERSION_ID_RE.match(version_id) is None:
193	                    raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad upload record")
194	                records[session_id]["version_id"] = version_id
195	        versioning = {}
196	        raw_versioning = document.get("versioning", {})
197	        if not isinstance(raw_versioning, dict):
198	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: versioning is not a map")
199	        for tenant, flag in raw_versioning.items():
200	            if not isinstance(tenant, str) or _TENANT_RE.match(tenant) is None:
201	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad versioning tenant")
202	            if not isinstance(flag, bool):
203	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad versioning flag")
204	            if flag:
205	                versioning[tenant] = True
206	        versions = {}
207	        raw_versions = document.get("versions", {})
208	        if not isinstance(raw_versions, dict):
209	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: versions is not a map")
210	        for tenant, keymap in raw_versions.items():
211	            if not isinstance(tenant, str) or _TENANT_RE.match(tenant) is None:
212	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad versions tenant")
213	            if not isinstance(keymap, dict):
214	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad tenant versions")
215	            loaded = {}
216	            for key, entries in keymap.items():
217	                if not isinstance(key, str) or not isinstance(entries, list):
218	                    raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad version list")
219	                loaded[key] = [self._validate_version(key, entry)
220	                               for entry in entries]
221	            if loaded:
222	                versions[tenant] = loaded
223	        retention = {}
224	        raw_retention = document.get("retention", {})
225	        if not isinstance(raw_retention, dict):
226	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: retention is not a map")
227	        for tenant, policy in raw_retention.items():
228	            if not isinstance(tenant, str) or _TENANT_RE.match(tenant) is None:
229	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad retention tenant")
230	            retention[tenant] = self._validate_policy(policy)
231	        quota = {}
232	        raw_quota = document.get("quota", {})
233	        if not isinstance(raw_quota, dict):
234	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: quota is not a map")
235	        for tenant, policy in raw_quota.items():
236	            if not isinstance(tenant, str) or _TENANT_RE.match(tenant) is None:
237	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad quota tenant")
238	            quota[tenant] = self._validate_quota(policy)
239	        lifecycle = {}
240	        raw_lifecycle = document.get("lifecycle", {})
241	        if not isinstance(raw_lifecycle, dict):
242	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: lifecycle is not a map")
243	        for tenant, policy in raw_lifecycle.items():
244	            if not isinstance(tenant, str) or _TENANT_RE.match(tenant) is None:
245	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad lifecycle tenant")
246	            lifecycle[tenant] = self._validate_lifecycle_policy(policy)
247	        return (objects, timestamps, records, versioning, versions,
248	                retention, quota, lifecycle)

250	    def _load_object_map(self, mapping):
251	        objects, timestamps = {}, {}
252	        for key, entry in mapping.items():
253	            if not isinstance(key, str):
254	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: non-string key")
255	            objects[key], last_modified = self._validate_entry(key, entry)
256	            if last_modified is not None:
257	                timestamps[key] = last_modified
258	        return objects, timestamps

260	    @staticmethod
261	    def _validate_entry(key, entry):
262	        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
263	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: entry for %r is not an object" % (key,))
264	        sha, size = entry.get("sha256"), entry.get("size")
265	        content_type = entry.get("content_type")
266	        if not _is_sha256(sha):
267	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad sha256 for %r" % (key,))
268	        if isinstance(size, bool) or not isinstance(size, int) or size < 0:
269	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad size for %r" % (key,))
270	        if content_type is not None and not isinstance(content_type, str):
271	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad content_type for %r" % (key,))
272	        last_modified = entry.get("last_modified")
273	        if last_modified is not None:
274	            if not isinstance(last_modified, str):
275	                raise ObjectStoreError(
276	                    "corrupted index: bad last_modified for %r" % (key,))
277	            try:
278	                datetime.fromisoformat(last_modified)
279	            except ValueError:
280	                raise ObjectStoreError(
281	                    "corrupted index: bad last_modified for %r" % (key,))
282	        return ({"sha256": sha, "size": size, "content_type": content_type},
283	                last_modified)

285	    def _validate_version(self, key, entry):
286	        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
287	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: version for %r is not an object" % (key,))
288	        version_id = entry.get("version_id")
289	        if not isinstance(version_id, str) or _VERSION_ID_RE.match(version_id) is None:
290	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad version_id for %r" % (key,))
291	        created_at = entry.get("created_at")
292	        if not isinstance(created_at, str):
293	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad created_at for %r" % (key,))
294	        base = self._validate_entry(key, entry)[0]
295	        return {"version_id": version_id, "sha256": base["sha256"],
296	                "size": base["size"], "content_type": base["content_type"],
297	                "created_at": created_at}

299	    @staticmethod
300	    def _validate_policy(policy):
301	        if not isinstance(policy, dict):
302	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad retention policy")
303	        loaded = {}
304	        for name in ("max_versions", "max_age_seconds"):
305	            value = policy.get(name)
306	            if value is None:
307	                continue
308	            if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or value < 0:
309	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad retention policy")
310	            loaded[name] = value
311	        if not loaded:
312	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad retention policy")
313	        return loaded
314	
315	    @staticmethod
316	    def _validate_quota(policy):
317	        if not isinstance(policy, dict):
318	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad quota policy")
319	        loaded = {}
320	        for name in ("max_bytes", "max_objects"):
321	            value = policy.get(name)
322	            if value is None:
323	                continue
324	            if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or value < 0:
325	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad quota policy")
326	            loaded[name] = value
327	        if not loaded:
328	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad quota policy")
329	        return loaded
330	
331	    @staticmethod
332	    def _validate_lifecycle_policy(policy):
333	        if not isinstance(policy, dict):
334	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad lifecycle policy")
335	        prefix = policy.get("prefix", "")
336	        if not isinstance(prefix, str):
337	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted index: bad lifecycle policy")
338	        max_age = policy.get("max_age_seconds")

357	    def _save_index(self):

359	                    "objects": self._persist_object_map(
360	                        DEFAULT_TENANT, self._objects.get(DEFAULT_TENANT, {}))}
361	        tenants = {tenant: self._persist_object_map(tenant, mapping)
362	                   for tenant, mapping in self._objects.items()
363	                   if tenant != DEFAULT_TENANT and mapping}
364	        if tenants:
365	            document["tenants"] = tenants
366	        if self._upload_records:
367	            records = {}
368	            for session_id, record in self._upload_records.items():
369	                saved = {"key": record["key"], "entry": record["entry"]}
370	                if record["tenant"] != DEFAULT_TENANT:
371	                    saved["tenant"] = record["tenant"]

373	                    saved["version_id"] = record["version_id"]

377	            document["versioning"] = {
378	                tenant: True for tenant in sorted(self._versioning)
379	                if self._versioning[tenant]
380	            }

382	                    if keymap}
383	        if versions:
384	            document["versions"] = versions

386	            document["retention"] = self._retention

388	            document["quota"] = self._quota

390	            document["lifecycle"] = self._lifecycle

417	    @staticmethod
418	    def _require_sha(sha256):
419	        if not _is_sha256(sha256):
420	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid sha256: %r" % (sha256,))

423	    @staticmethod
424	    def _check_precondition(expected_sha256):
425	        """Normalize an ``expected_sha256`` keyword argument.
426	
427	        Omitted (the ``_MISSING`` sentinel) means no condition; an explicit
428	        ``None`` means the key must not exist; a 64-digit lowercase hex string
429	        means the key must exist with that exact digest. Anything else is an
430	        ``invalid precondition`` error rather than a failed condition.
431	        """
432	        if expected_sha256 is _MISSING:
433	            return _MISSING
434	        if expected_sha256 is None:
435	            return None
436	        if _is_sha256(expected_sha256):
437	            return expected_sha256
438	        raise ObjectStoreError("invalid precondition")

440	    def _precondition_met(self, tenant, key, expected):
441	        """Return whether *key* in *tenant* currently satisfies *expected*."""
442	        entry = self._objects.get(tenant, {}).get(key)
443	        if expected is None:
444	            return entry is None
445	        return entry is not None and entry["sha256"] == expected

447	    # -- object API ----------------------------------------------------
448	    def put(self, key, payload, content_type=None, expected_sha256=_MISSING,
449	            tenant=DEFAULT_TENANT):
450	        """Store *payload* under *key* in *tenant* and return its metadata.
451	
452	        *expected_sha256* is an atomic precondition on the key's current
453	        digest in the same tenant: omitted leaves the old overwrite
454	        behaviour, an explicit ``None`` requires the key not to exist, and a
455	        64 lowercase hex digest requires the key to exist with exactly that
456	        digest. Content type and other keys are not compared. Objects of
457	        other tenants are never consulted or touched.
458	
459	        When *tenant* has versioning enabled the write also appends an
460	        immutable version to the key's version list, makes it the current
461	        version and includes its ``version_id`` in the returned metadata.
462	
463	        When *tenant* has a quota policy, the write is rejected with
464	        ``ObjectStoreError("quota exceeded")`` before any data lands when
465	        the resulting usage would exceed a saved limit.
466	        """
467	        self._check_tenant(tenant)
468	        self._check_key(key)
469	        if not isinstance(payload, (bytes, bytearray, memoryview)):
470	            raise ObjectStoreError("payload must be bytes")
471	        if content_type is not None and not isinstance(content_type, str):
472	            raise ObjectStoreError("content_type must be a string or None")
473	        expected = self._check_precondition(expected_sha256)
474	        data = bytes(payload)
475	        sha = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
476	        entry = {"sha256": sha, "size": len(data), "content_type": content_type}
477	        with self._lock:
478	            if expected is not _MISSING and not self._precondition_met(
479	                    tenant, key, expected):
480	                raise ObjectStoreError("precondition failed")
481	            versioning_on = self._versioning.get(tenant, False)
482	            delta_bytes, delta_objects = self._publish_delta(
483	                tenant, key, entry, versioning_on)
484	            self._enforce_quota(tenant, delta_bytes, delta_objects)
485	            self._store_blob(sha, data)
486	            self._objects.setdefault(tenant, {})[key] = entry
487	            self._timestamps.setdefault(tenant, {})[key] = \
488	                datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
489	            version_id = None
490	            if versioning_on:
491	                version_id = self._append_version(tenant, key, entry)
492	            self._save_index()
493	            result = dict(entry)
494	            if version_id is not None:
495	                result["version_id"] = version_id
496	            return result

498	    def _append_version(self, tenant, key, entry):
499	        """Append a new immutable version for *key* and return its id.
500	
501	        Must be called under the store lock; the caller makes the matching
502	        current-pointer update and saves the index.
503	        """
504	        versions = self._versions.setdefault(tenant, {}).setdefault(key, [])
505	        existing = {version["version_id"] for version in versions}
506	        while True:
507	            version_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
508	            if version_id not in existing:
509	                break
510	        versions.append({
511	            "version_id": version_id,
512	            "sha256": entry["sha256"],
513	            "size": entry["size"],
514	            "content_type": entry["content_type"],
515	            "created_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
516	        })
517	        return version_id

519	    def _store_blob(self, sha, data):
520	        """Write the blob for *sha* when missing and repair it when corrupted.
521	
522	        An existing file is hashed on every put. Intact files are left exactly
523	        as they are so dedup costs nothing extra; a file whose digest no longer
524	        matches is rewritten atomically from the complete *data*, so an
525	        interrupted repair leaves either the old bytes or the full new bytes.
526	        """
527	        path = os.path.join(self.blobs_dir, sha)
528	        if os.path.exists(path):
529	            try:
530	                with open(path, "rb") as handle:
531	                    stored = handle.read()
532	            except FileNotFoundError:
533	                stored = None
534	            except OSError:
535	                raise ObjectStoreError("blob io error")
536	            if stored is not None:
537	                if hashlib.sha256(stored).hexdigest() == sha:
538	                    return
539	                try:
540	                    _atomic_write(path, data)
541	                except OSError:
542	                    raise ObjectStoreError("blob io error")
543	                return
544	        try:
545	            _atomic_write(path, data)
546	        except OSError:
547	            raise ObjectStoreError("blob io error")

549	    def get(self, key, tenant=DEFAULT_TENANT):
550	        """Return ``(payload, entry)`` for *key* in *tenant*."""
551	        self._check_tenant(tenant)
552	        with self._lock:
553	            entry = self.head(key, tenant=tenant)
554	            data = self.blob(entry["sha256"])
555	            if len(data) != entry["size"]:
556	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted blob")
557	            return data, entry

559	    def head(self, key, tenant=DEFAULT_TENANT):
560	        """Return a copy of the metadata entry for *key* in *tenant*."""
561	        self._check_tenant(tenant)
562	        self._check_key(key)
563	        with self._lock:
564	            entry = self._objects.get(tenant, {}).get(key)
565	            if entry is None:
566	                raise ObjectStoreError("not found: %s" % (key,))
567	            return dict(entry)

569	    def delete(self, key, expected_sha256=_MISSING, tenant=DEFAULT_TENANT):
570	        """Drop *key* in *tenant*; shared blobs stay on disk for other keys.
571	
572	        With *expected_sha256*, deletion also requires the key's current
573	        digest in this tenant to match (or an explicit ``None`` requires the
574	        key absent); a satisfied absent-condition delete still reports the
575	        key as not found. Objects other tenants keep under the same key are
576	        unaffected.
577	
578	        When *tenant* has versioning enabled and the key has versions, only
579	        the current version is removed: the newest remaining version becomes
580	        current, and the key disappears entirely once no version remains.
581	        """
582	        self._check_tenant(tenant)
583	        self._check_key(key)
584	        expected = self._check_precondition(expected_sha256)
585	        with self._lock:
586	            objects = self._objects.get(tenant, {})
587	            if key not in objects:
588	                raise ObjectStoreError("not found: %s" % (key,))
589	            if expected is not _MISSING and not self._precondition_met(
590	                    tenant, key, expected):
591	                raise ObjectStoreError("precondition failed")
592	            self._remove_current_unlocked(tenant, key)
593	            self._save_index()
594	
595	    def _remove_current_unlocked(self, tenant, key):
596	        """Remove *key*'s current object the way :meth:`delete` does.
597	
598	        Versioned tenants pop the current version and promote the newest
599	        remaining one; unversioned tenants drop the mapping outright. When a
600	        version is promoted its ``created_at`` becomes the key's
601	        last-modified time (that content's last write); when the mapping is
602	        removed the saved timestamp is dropped with it. Must be called under
603	        the store lock with *key* present; returns the removed current entry.
604	        """
605	        objects = self._objects[tenant]
606	        removed = dict(objects[key])
607	        versions = self._versions.get(tenant, {}).get(key)
608	        if self._versioning.get(tenant, False) and versions:
609	            versions.pop()
610	            if versions:
611	                promoted = versions[-1]
612	                objects[key] = {"sha256": promoted["sha256"],
613	                                "size": promoted["size"],
614	                                "content_type": promoted["content_type"]}
615	                self._timestamps.setdefault(tenant, {})[key] = \
616	                    promoted["created_at"]
617	            else:
618	                del objects[key]
619	                self._timestamps.get(tenant, {}).pop(key, None)
620	                self._drop_versions_key(tenant, key)
621	        else:
622	            del objects[key]
623	            self._timestamps.get(tenant, {}).pop(key, None)
624	        return removed
625	
626	    def _drop_versions_key(self, tenant, key):
627	        """Remove *key*'s (empty) version list and prune empty parent maps."""
628	        keymap = self._versions.get(tenant)
629	        if keymap is None:
630	            return
631	        keymap.pop(key, None)
632	        if not keymap:
633	            del self._versions[tenant]

635	    def blob(self, sha256):
636	        """Return the raw bytes stored under digest *sha256*.
637	
638	        The digest of the bytes actually on disk is recomputed on every read,
639	        so truncation, appended bytes and same-length tampering are all
640	        rejected instead of being handed back to the caller.
641	        """
642	        self._require_sha(sha256)
643	        with self._lock:
644	            try:
645	                with open(os.path.join(self.blobs_dir, sha256), "rb") as handle:
646	                    data = handle.read()
647	            except FileNotFoundError:
648	                raise ObjectStoreError("not found: blob %s" % (sha256,))
649	            except OSError:
650	                raise ObjectStoreError("blob io error")
651	            if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != sha256:
652	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted blob")
653	            return data
654	
655	    def blob_digests(self):
656	        """Return the sorted digests currently present in the blob directory."""
657	        with self._lock:
658	            return sorted(name for name in os.listdir(self.blobs_dir) if _is_sha256(name))

660	    # -- resumable uploads ----------------------------------------------
661	    def _session_meta_path(self, session_id):
662	        return os.path.join(self.uploads_dir, session_id + ".json")

664	    def _session_part_path(self, session_id):
665	        return os.path.join(self.uploads_dir, session_id + ".part")

667	    def _load_uploads(self):
668	        uploads = {}
669	        try:
670	            names = os.listdir(self.uploads_dir)
671	        except FileNotFoundError:
672	            return uploads
673	        except OSError:
674	            raise ObjectStoreError("upload io error")
675	        for name in sorted(names):
676	            match = _SESSION_META_RE.match(name)
677	            if match is None:
678	                continue
679	            session_id = match.group(1)
680	            if session_id in self._upload_records:
681	                # completed before a crash could clean its files up
682	                self._discard_session_files(session_id)
683	                continue
684	            session = self._read_session_meta(session_id)
685	            self._check_part_file(session_id, session["offset"])
686	            uploads[session_id] = session
687	        return uploads

689	    def _read_session_meta(self, session_id):
690	        try:
691	            with open(self._session_meta_path(session_id), "rb") as handle:
692	                document = json.loads(handle.read().decode("utf-8"))
693	        except (OSError, ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:
694	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted upload session: %s" % (exc,))
695	        if not isinstance(document, dict):
696	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted upload session: not an object")
697	        key = document.get("key")
698	        size = document.get("size")
699	        sha = document.get("sha256")
700	        content_type = document.get("content_type")
701	        offset = document.get("offset")
702	        expected = document.get("expected_sha256", _MISSING)
703	        tenant = document.get("tenant", DEFAULT_TENANT)
704	        try:
705	            self._check_key(key)
706	        except ObjectStoreError:
707	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted upload session: bad key")
708	        if not isinstance(tenant, str) or _TENANT_RE.match(tenant) is None:
709	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted upload session: bad tenant")
710	        if isinstance(size, bool) or not isinstance(size, int) or size < 0:
711	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted upload session: bad size")
712	        if not _is_sha256(sha):
713	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted upload session: bad sha256")
714	        if content_type is not None and not isinstance(content_type, str):
715	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted upload session: bad content_type")
716	        if isinstance(offset, bool) or not isinstance(offset, int) or not 0 <= offset <= size:
717	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted upload session: bad offset")
718	        # Sessions written by older versions have no condition; an explicit
719	        # null requires the key absent, a string requires that digest.
720	        if expected is not _MISSING and expected is not None and not _is_sha256(expected):
721	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted upload session: bad precondition")
722	        return {"key": key, "size": size, "sha256": sha,
723	                "content_type": content_type, "offset": offset,
724	                "expected_sha256": expected, "tenant": tenant}

726	    def _check_part_file(self, session_id, offset):
727	        """Ensure the part file holds exactly the confirmed *offset* bytes.
728	
729	        A crash between the chunk write and the metadata update can leave
730	        unconfirmed bytes behind; they are truncated so recovery sees either
731	        the old progress or a whole confirmed chunk, never a partial one.
732	        """
733	        path = self._session_part_path(session_id)
734	        try:
735	            size_on_disk = os.stat(path).st_size
736	        except FileNotFoundError:
737	            if offset:
738	                raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted upload session: missing data")
739	            try:
740	                with open(path, "wb"):
741	                    pass
742	            except OSError:
743	                raise ObjectStoreError("upload io error")
744	            return
745	        except OSError:
746	            raise ObjectStoreError("upload io error")
747	        if size_on_disk < offset:
748	            raise ObjectStoreError("corrupted upload session: truncated data")
749	        if size_on_disk > offset:
750	            try:
751	                with open(path, "r+b") as handle:
752	                    handle.truncate(offset)
753	                    handle.flush()
754	                    os.fsync(handle.fileno())
755	            except OSError:
756	                raise ObjectStoreError("upload io error")

758	    def _save_session(self, session_id, session):
759	        # The default tenant is implicit so older session files stay
760	        # byte-identical; every other tenant is recorded explicitly.
761	        document = {name: value for name, value in session.items()
762	                    if value is not _MISSING
763	                    and not (name == "tenant" and value == DEFAULT_TENANT)}
764	        payload = json.dumps(document, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
765	        try:
766	            _atomic_write(self._session_meta_path(session_id),
767	                          payload.encode("utf-8") + b"\n")
768	        except OSError:
769	            raise ObjectStoreError("upload io error")

772	        try:
773	            with open(self._session_part_path(session_id), "r+b") as handle:
774	                handle.seek(offset)
775	                handle.write(data)
776	                handle.flush()
777	                os.fsync(handle.fileno())
778	        except OSError:
779	            raise ObjectStoreError("upload io error")

781	    def _read_part(self, session_id, offset, length):
782	        try:
783	            with open(self._session_part_path(session_id), "rb") as handle:
784	                handle.seek(offset)
785	                return handle.read(length)
786	        except OSError:
787	            raise ObjectStoreError("upload io error")

811	            os.rmdir(self.uploads_dir)

815	    def _new_session_id(self):
816	        while True:
817	            session_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
818	            if session_id in self._uploads or session_id in self._upload_records:
819	                continue
820	            if os.path.exists(self._session_meta_path(session_id)):
821	                continue
822	            return session_id

824	    @staticmethod

826	        if not isinstance(session_id, str) or not session_id:
827	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid upload session: %r" % (session_id,))

830	    def _require_active_session(self, session_id, tenant):
831	        self._check_session_id(session_id)
832	        record = self._upload_records.get(session_id)
833	        if record is not None and record["tenant"] == tenant:
834	            raise SessionConflict(
835	                "upload session already completed: %s" % (session_id,))
836	        session = self._uploads.get(session_id)
837	        if session is None or session["tenant"] != tenant:
838	            # Sessions of other tenants are indistinguishable from unknown
839	            # ones: no state or progress leaks across tenant boundaries.
840	            raise ObjectStoreError("unknown upload session: %r" % (session_id,))

843	    def begin_upload(self, key, size, sha256, content_type=None,
844	                     expected_sha256=_MISSING, tenant=DEFAULT_TENANT):
845	        """Start a resumable upload session and return its unique id.
846	
847	        The key and content type follow the same rules as :meth:`put`, *size*
848	        must be a non-negative integer (booleans excluded) and *sha256* the
849	        64 lowercase hex digits of the full content's digest. Creating a
850	        session changes no object; the session and its progress survive
851	        reopening the data directory. The session belongs to *tenant* for its
852	        whole lifetime: every later operation must name the same tenant.
853	
854	        *expected_sha256* saves the same kind of precondition as :meth:`put`;
855	        it is checked once, atomically with the publish, when the session
856	        completes, never while the session is created or appended to.
857	
858	        The session reserves its declared *size* against the tenant's
859	        ``max_bytes`` quota for its whole lifetime: when current usage plus
860	        the reservations of all active sessions (this one included) would
861	        exceed the limit, no session is created and
862	        ``ObjectStoreError("quota exceeded")`` is raised.
863	        """
864	        self._check_tenant(tenant)
865	        self._check_key(key)
866	        if isinstance(size, bool) or not isinstance(size, int) or size < 0:
867	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid size: %r" % (size,))
868	        self._require_sha(sha256)
869	        if content_type is not None and not isinstance(content_type, str):
870	            raise ObjectStoreError("content_type must be a string or None")
871	        expected = self._check_precondition(expected_sha256)
872	        session = {"key": key, "size": size, "sha256": sha256,
873	                   "content_type": content_type, "offset": 0,
874	                   "expected_sha256": expected, "tenant": tenant}
875	        with self._lock:
876	            self._enforce_reservation(tenant, size)
877	            session_id = self._new_session_id()
878	            try:
879	                os.makedirs(self.uploads_dir, exist_ok=True)
880	                with open(self._session_part_path(session_id), "wb"):
881	                    pass
882	            except OSError:
883	                raise ObjectStoreError("upload io error")
884	            try:
885	                self._save_session(session_id, session)
886	            except ObjectStoreError:
887	                self._discard_session_files(session_id)
888	                raise
889	            self._uploads[session_id] = session
890	            return session_id

920	    def append_upload(self, session_id, offset, payload, tenant=DEFAULT_TENANT):
921	        """Append one chunk to *session_id* and return the received length.
922	
923	        A new chunk must start exactly at the current end and may not exceed
924	        the declared total size. A chunk lying fully inside the received
925	        range succeeds without growing when its bytes are identical to what
926	        is stored, and fails otherwise; chunks overlapping the end, chunks
927	        past the end and empty chunks anywhere but at the end all fail.
928	        """
929	        self._check_tenant(tenant)
930	        self._check_session_id(session_id)
931	        if isinstance(offset, bool) or not isinstance(offset, int) or offset < 0:
932	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid offset: %r" % (offset,))
933	        if not isinstance(payload, (bytes, bytearray, memoryview)):
934	            raise ObjectStoreError("payload must be bytes")
935	        data = bytes(payload)
936	        with self._lock:
937	            session = self._require_active_session(session_id, tenant)
938	            current = session["offset"]
939	            if offset > current:
940	                raise SessionConflict(
941	                    "append gap: offset %d beyond received %d" % (offset, current))
942	            if not data:
943	                if offset != current:
944	                    raise SessionConflict("empty chunk only at received end")
945	                return current
946	            end = offset + len(data)
947	            if offset < current:
948	                if end > current:
949	                    raise SessionConflict("append overlaps received end")
950	                if self._read_part(session_id, offset, len(data)) != data:
951	                    raise SessionConflict("append conflicts with received bytes")
952	                return current
953	            if end > session["size"]:
954	                raise SessionConflict("append exceeds declared size")
955	            self._write_part(session_id, offset, data)
956	            self._save_session(session_id, dict(session, offset=end))
957	            session["offset"] = end
958	            return end

960	    def complete_upload(self, session_id, tenant=DEFAULT_TENANT):
961	        """Publish the object once the received content matches the declaration.
962	
963	        The total length and the SHA-256 of the full content must match the
964	        declared values (zero-byte objects included); only then is the
965	        session's saved precondition checked against the owning tenant's
966	        object state at publish time and the object published in that
967	        tenant, all as one indivisible step. A failed precondition raises
968	        without changing the object, the session's confirmed bytes or any
969	        blob, so the session can be completed again (or aborted) later.
970	        A quota policy on the tenant is enforced the same way: the session's
971	        own reservation is released first, and when the publish would exceed
972	        a saved limit ``ObjectStoreError("quota exceeded")`` is raised
973	        without changing anything. Repeating a completed call returns the
974	        first result without touching the key again, so later writes or
975	        deletes of the key are never overwritten.
976	        """
977	        self._check_tenant(tenant)
978	        self._check_session_id(session_id)
979	        with self._lock:
980	            record = self._upload_records.get(session_id)
981	            if record is not None:
982	                if record["tenant"] != tenant:
983	                    raise ObjectStoreError(
984	                        "unknown upload session: %r" % (session_id,))
985	                entry = dict(record["entry"])
986	                if record.get("version_id") is not None:
987	                    entry["version_id"] = record["version_id"]
988	                return entry
989	            session = self._uploads.get(session_id)
990	            if session is None or session["tenant"] != tenant:
991	                raise ObjectStoreError("unknown upload session: %r" % (session_id,))
992	            if session["offset"] != session["size"]:
993	                raise SessionConflict(
994	                    "upload incomplete: %d of %d bytes received"
995	                    % (session["offset"], session["size"]))
996	            data = self._read_part(session_id, 0, session["size"])
997	            if len(data) != session["size"]:
998	                raise ObjectStoreError("upload io error")
999	            if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != session["sha256"]:
1000	                raise SessionConflict("upload hash mismatch")
1001	            expected = session.get("expected_sha256", _MISSING)
1002	            if expected is not _MISSING and not self._precondition_met(
1003	                    tenant, session["key"], expected):
1004	                raise ObjectStoreError("precondition failed")
1005	            entry = {"sha256": session["sha256"], "size": session["size"],
1006	                     "content_type": session["content_type"]}
1007	            # The session's own reservation is lifted before the quota check:
1008	            # its reserved bytes become the used bytes being published.
1009	            versioning_on = self._versioning.get(tenant, False)
1010	            delta_bytes, delta_objects = self._publish_delta(
1011	                tenant, session["key"], entry, versioning_on)
1012	            self._enforce_quota(tenant, delta_bytes, delta_objects,
1013	                                release_session=session)
1014	            self._store_blob(session["sha256"], data)
1015	            objects = self._objects.setdefault(tenant, {})
1016	            timestamps = self._timestamps.setdefault(tenant, {})
1017	            previous = objects.get(session["key"], _MISSING)
1018	            previous_time = timestamps.get(session["key"], _MISSING)
1019	            published_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
1020	            objects[session["key"]] = entry
1021	            timestamps[session["key"]] = published_at
1022	            version_id = None
1023	            if versioning_on:
1024	                version_id = self._append_version(tenant, session["key"], entry)
1025	            record = {"key": session["key"], "entry": dict(entry),
1026	                      "tenant": tenant}
1027	            if version_id is not None:
1028	                record["version_id"] = version_id
1029	            self._upload_records[session_id] = record
1030	            try:
1031	                self._save_index()
1032	            except OSError:
1033	                del self._upload_records[session_id]
1034	                if version_id is not None:
1035	                    self._versions[tenant][session["key"]].pop()
1036	                    self._drop_versions_key(tenant, session["key"])
1037	                if previous is _MISSING:
1038	                    del objects[session["key"]]
1039	                else:
1040	                    objects[session["key"]] = previous
1041	                if previous_time is _MISSING:
1042	                    timestamps.pop(session["key"], None)
1043	                else:
1044	                    timestamps[session["key"]] = previous_time
1045	                raise ObjectStoreError("upload io error")
1046	            del self._uploads[session_id]
1047	            self._discard_session_files(session_id)
1048	            result = dict(entry)
1049	            if version_id is not None:
1050	                result["version_id"] = version_id
1051	            return result

1078	    def collect_garbage(self, dry_run=True):
1079	        """Collect unreferenced blobs, previewing by default.
1080	
1081	        Returns ``{"digests": [...], "bytes": <int>, "dry_run": <bool>}``. The
1082	        digests are sorted lexicographically and bytes is the sum of the actual
1083	        file sizes; a dry run reports the candidates without touching storage,
1084	        an actual run reports the files deleted by that call. Only regular
1085	        files directly in the blobs directory whose names are 64 lowercase hex
1086	        digits are eligible: subdirectories, symlinks, temporary files and any
1087	        other names are left untouched, and symlink targets are never opened.
1088	
1089	        References are recomputed from the current object index on every
1090	        call, across every tenant and including digest sharing between keys.
1091	        Blobs referenced by any retained object version or declared by an
1092	        incomplete upload session are live as well. The whole operation runs
1093	        under the store lock, so blobs published
1094	        concurrently stay referenced and candidates that vanished between
1095	        the scan and deletion are skipped rather than counted.
1096	        """
1097	        if not isinstance(dry_run, bool):
1098	            raise ObjectStoreError("invalid dry_run")
1099	        with self._lock:
1100	            referenced = {
1101	                entry["sha256"]
1102	                for objects in self._objects.values()
1103	                for entry in objects.values()
1104	            }
1105	            for keymap in self._versions.values():
1106	                for versions in keymap.values():
1107	                    for version in versions:
1108	                        referenced.add(version["sha256"])
1109	            for session in self._uploads.values():
1110	                referenced.add(session["sha256"])
1111	            try:
1112	                names = os.listdir(self.blobs_dir)
1113	            except OSError:
1114	                raise ObjectStoreError("gc io error")
1115	            candidates = []
1116	            for name in names:
1117	                if not _is_sha256(name) or name in referenced:
1118	                    continue
1119	                path = os.path.join(self.blobs_dir, name)
1120	                try:
1121	                    info = os.lstat(path)
1122	                except FileNotFoundError:
1123	                    continue
1124	                except OSError:
1125	                    raise ObjectStoreError("gc io error")
1126	                if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode):
1127	                    continue
1128	                candidates.append((name, info.st_size))
1129	            candidates.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])
1130	            if dry_run:
1131	                return {
1132	                    "digests": [name for name, _ in candidates],
1133	                    "bytes": sum(size for _, size in candidates),
1134	                    "dry_run": True,
1135	                }
1136	            deleted = []
1137	            freed = 0
1138	            for name, size in candidates:
1139	                path = os.path.join(self.blobs_dir, name)
1140	                try:
1141	                    os.remove(path)
1142	                except FileNotFoundError:
1143	                    continue
1144	                except OSError:
1145	                    raise ObjectStoreError("gc io error")
1146	                deleted.append(name)
1147	                freed += size
1148	            return {"digests": deleted, "bytes": freed, "dry_run": False}

1395	            policy = self._retention.get(tenant)
1396	            if policy is None:

"""End-to-end tests for the quota and usage HTTP endpoints."""

import hashlib
import http.client
import json
import os
import shutil
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest

from objstore.http_app import create_server
from objstore.store import ContentAddressedStore


def sha(payload):
    return hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()


TENANT = {"X-Objstore-Tenant": "acme"}


class HTTPQuotaTestCase(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.root = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="objstore-http-quota-")
        cls.store = ContentAddressedStore(cls.root)
        cls.server = create_server(cls.store, "127.0.0.1", 0)
        cls.port = cls.server.server_address[1]
        cls.thread = threading.Thread(target=cls.server.serve_forever,
                                      kwargs={"poll_interval": 0.05}, daemon=True)
        cls.thread.start()

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        cls.server.shutdown()
        cls.server.server_close()
        cls.thread.join(timeout=10)
        shutil.rmtree(cls.root, ignore_errors=True)

    def request(self, method, path, body=None, headers=None):
        conn = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", self.port, timeout=15)
        try:
            conn.request(method, path, body=body, headers=headers or {})
            response = conn.getresponse()
            payload = response.read()
            return response.status, {k.lower(): v for k, v in response.getheaders()}, payload
        finally:
            conn.close()

    def document(self, payload):
        return json.loads(payload.decode("utf-8"))

    def set_quota(self, tenant, **policy):
        status, _, body = self.request(
            "PUT", "/v1/quota", json.dumps(policy),
            {"X-Objstore-Tenant": tenant})
        assert status == 200, body


class TestQuotaEndpoint(HTTPQuotaTestCase):
    def test_get_defaults_to_nulls(self):
        status, _, body = self.request(
            "GET", "/v1/quota", headers={"X-Objstore-Tenant": "t-unset"})
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(self.document(body),
                         {"max_bytes": None, "max_objects": None})

    def test_put_and_get_roundtrip(self):
        headers = {"X-Objstore-Tenant": "t-round"}
        status, _, body = self.request("PUT", "/v1/quota",
                                       json.dumps({"max_bytes": 100,
                                                   "max_objects": 3}), headers)
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(self.document(body),
                         {"max_bytes": 100, "max_objects": 3})
        status, _, body = self.request("GET", "/v1/quota", headers=headers)
        self.assertEqual(self.document(body),
                         {"max_bytes": 100, "max_objects": 3})

    def test_put_single_limit(self):
        headers = {"X-Objstore-Tenant": "t-single"}
        status, _, body = self.request("PUT", "/v1/quota",
                                       json.dumps({"max_bytes": 64}), headers)
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(self.document(body),
                         {"max_bytes": 64, "max_objects": None})

    def test_put_rejects_invalid_policies(self):
        headers = {"X-Objstore-Tenant": "t-bad"}
        for document in ({}, {"max_bytes": None, "max_objects": None},
                         {"max_bytes": -1}, {"max_objects": -1},
                         {"max_bytes": True}, {"max_objects": False},
                         {"max_bytes": "100"}, {"max_objects": 1.5},
                         {"max_bytes": 1, "unknown": 2}, {"max_byte": 1}):
            status, _, body = self.request("PUT", "/v1/quota",
                                           json.dumps(document), headers)
            self.assertEqual(status, 400, document)
            self.assertEqual(self.document(body), {"error": "invalid quota"})

    def test_put_rejects_non_object_json(self):
        status, _, body = self.request("PUT", "/v1/quota", "[1, 2]",
                                       {"X-Objstore-Tenant": "t-badjson"})
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)
        self.assertTrue(self.document(body)["error"].startswith("invalid json"))

    def test_delete_clears_policy(self):
        headers = {"X-Objstore-Tenant": "t-clear"}
        self.request("PUT", "/v1/quota", json.dumps({"max_bytes": 10}), headers)
        status, _, body = self.request("DELETE", "/v1/quota", headers=headers)
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(self.document(body),
                         {"max_bytes": None, "max_objects": None})
        status, _, body = self.request("GET", "/v1/quota", headers=headers)
        self.assertEqual(self.document(body),
                         {"max_bytes": None, "max_objects": None})

    def test_methods_not_allowed(self):
        for method, path in (("POST", "/v1/quota"), ("HEAD", "/v1/quota"),
                             ("PUT", "/v1/usage"), ("DELETE", "/v1/usage"),
                             ("POST", "/v1/usage")):
            status, _, _ = self.request(method, path, headers=TENANT)
            self.assertEqual(status, 405, (method, path))

    def test_invalid_tenant_header(self):
        status, _, body = self.request(
            "GET", "/v1/quota", headers={"X-Objstore-Tenant": "BAD!"})
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)
        self.assertTrue(self.document(body)["error"].startswith("invalid tenant"))

    def test_quota_is_tenant_scoped(self):
        self.set_quota("t-scoped", max_objects=1)
        status, _, _ = self.request(
            "PUT", "/v1/objects/scoped-a", b"1",
            {"X-Objstore-Tenant": "t-scoped"})
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        status, _, body = self.request(
            "PUT", "/v1/objects/scoped-b", b"2",
            {"X-Objstore-Tenant": "t-scoped"})
        self.assertEqual(status, 413)
        self.assertEqual(self.document(body), {"error": "quota exceeded"})
        # The default tenant stays unlimited.
        status, _, _ = self.request("PUT", "/v1/objects/scoped-a", b"1")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        status, _, _ = self.request("PUT", "/v1/objects/scoped-b", b"2")
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)


class TestUsageEndpoint(HTTPQuotaTestCase):
    def test_usage_fields(self):
        tenant = "t-usage"
        headers = {"X-Objstore-Tenant": tenant}
        status, _, body = self.request("GET", "/v1/usage", headers=headers)
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(self.document(body),
                         {"used_bytes": 0, "used_objects": 0,
                          "reserved_bytes": 0, "reserved_sessions": 0})
        self.request("PUT", "/v1/objects/u1", b"hello", headers)
        self.request("PUT", "/v1/objects/u2", b"hello", headers)
        status, _, body = self.request("GET", "/v1/usage", headers=headers)
        self.assertEqual(self.document(body),
                         {"used_bytes": 10, "used_objects": 2,
                          "reserved_bytes": 0, "reserved_sessions": 0})

    def test_usage_counts_active_sessions(self):
        tenant = "t-usage-upload"
        headers = {"X-Objstore-Tenant": tenant}
        status, _, body = self.request(
            "POST", "/v1/uploads",
            json.dumps({"key": "big", "size": 100, "sha256": sha(b"x" * 100)}),
            headers)
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        session = self.document(body)["session"]
        status, _, body = self.request("GET", "/v1/usage", headers=headers)
        self.assertEqual(self.document(body),
                         {"used_bytes": 0, "used_objects": 0,
                          "reserved_bytes": 100, "reserved_sessions": 1})
        status, _, _ = self.request(
            "PUT", "/v1/uploads/%s?offset=0" % session, b"x" * 100, headers)
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        status, _, _ = self.request(
            "POST", "/v1/uploads/%s/complete" % session, headers=headers)
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        status, _, body = self.request("GET", "/v1/usage", headers=headers)
        self.assertEqual(self.document(body),
                         {"used_bytes": 100, "used_objects": 1,
                          "reserved_bytes": 0, "reserved_sessions": 0})


class TestQuotaEnforcement(HTTPQuotaTestCase):
    def test_put_object_over_quota_returns_413(self):
        tenant = "t-obj-quota"
        headers = {"X-Objstore-Tenant": tenant}
        self.set_quota(tenant, max_bytes=10)
        status, _, _ = self.request("PUT", "/v1/objects/k1", b"123456", headers)
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        status, _, body = self.request("PUT", "/v1/objects/k2", b"12345",
                                       headers)
        self.assertEqual(status, 413)
        self.assertEqual(self.document(body), {"error": "quota exceeded"})
        status, _, _ = self.request("GET", "/v1/objects/k2", headers=headers)
        self.assertEqual(status, 404)

    def test_begin_upload_over_quota_returns_413(self):
        tenant = "t-up-quota"
        headers = {"X-Objstore-Tenant": tenant}
        self.set_quota(tenant, max_bytes=10)
        self.request("PUT", "/v1/objects/k1", b"123456", headers)
        status, _, body = self.request(
            "POST", "/v1/uploads",
            json.dumps({"key": "big", "size": 5, "sha256": sha(b"x" * 5)}),
            headers)
        self.assertEqual(status, 413)
        self.assertEqual(self.document(body), {"error": "quota exceeded"})

    def test_complete_over_object_quota_returns_413(self):
        tenant = "t-complete-quota"
        headers = {"X-Objstore-Tenant": tenant}
        self.set_quota(tenant, max_objects=1)
        self.request("PUT", "/v1/objects/k1", b"1", headers)
        status, _, body = self.request(
            "POST", "/v1/uploads",
            json.dumps({"key": "k2", "size": 2, "sha256": sha(b"bb")}), headers)
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        session = self.document(body)["session"]
        self.request("PUT", "/v1/uploads/%s?offset=0" % session, b"bb", headers)
        status, _, body = self.request(
            "POST", "/v1/uploads/%s/complete" % session, headers=headers)
        self.assertEqual(status, 413)
        self.assertEqual(self.document(body), {"error": "quota exceeded"})
        status, _, _ = self.request("GET", "/v1/objects/k2", headers=headers)
        self.assertEqual(status, 404)

    def test_quota_io_error_returns_500(self):
        # Replacing the index path with a directory makes the atomic
        # temp-write-plus-replace fail with an OSError on every platform.
        if os.path.exists(self.store.index_path):
            os.remove(self.store.index_path)
        os.mkdir(self.store.index_path)
        try:
            status, _, body = self.request(
                "PUT", "/v1/quota", json.dumps({"max_bytes": 1}),
                {"X-Objstore-Tenant": "t-io"})
            self.assertEqual(status, 500)
            self.assertEqual(self.document(body), {"error": "quota io error"})
        finally:
            os.rmdir(self.store.index_path)

    def test_etag_and_condition_semantics_unchanged(self):
        tenant = "t-compat"
        headers = {"X-Objstore-Tenant": tenant}
        status, resp_headers, body = self.request(
            "PUT", "/v1/objects/c1", b"data", headers)
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        entry = self.document(body)
        status, resp_headers, _ = self.request("GET", "/v1/objects/c1",
                                               headers=headers)
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(resp_headers.get("etag"), '"%s"' % entry["sha256"])
        status, _, body = self.request(
            "PUT", "/v1/objects/c1", b"other",
            dict(headers, **{"If-None-Match": "*"}))
        self.assertEqual(status, 412)
        self.assertEqual(self.document(body), {"error": "precondition failed"})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
